source.view: 'Vaizdas iš šono' M 1:50 (vector CAD; 1 pt = 17.639 mm at 1:50)

volume_note_original: Standartinio gaminio be lentynos 1 m ilgio tūris ~ 0,29 m3 (sheets 06 and 07). 'Lentyna' = the top flange (notes: height is increased by thickening the lentyna).

half_profiles_mm._note: right half, from soffit centre-line edge upwards; x from axis, y from soffit. Vector coordinates scaled 1:50 and snapped to printed H, H-150 and bottom dimensions.

S-1000.note: does NOT match: +22 %; the note on sheet 06 appears copied from the S-850 sheet (drawing is dimensionally consistent at 1:50: 650/150/850/1000/340 all within 1 mm). Pinned in tests.

S-1150.note: drawing ~4 mm narrow at the base; printed values used, web line re-drawn to the vector fillet end

S-850-710.note: sheet 05 geometry is identical to sheet 07 (700 wide) but labelled 710; implemented with 710 by adding a 5 mm flat to the flange underside at each edge

geometry_notes: Outlines are the vector CAD polylines of the side views (PyMuPDF), scaled at 1:50; printed H, flange 150, web 1000/850/700 and bottom widths agree with the vectors to <= 1 mm except as listed in residuals.
The flange-to-web transition is a curved haunch drawn as a 6-chord polyline starting at the flange edge; the chords are kept as drawn.
All sections are solid T/trapezoid girders (no voids); the S-850 two variants differ only by printed top width (710 vs 700) and Lmax (24 vs 20.3 m).
Taller versions obtained by thickening the flange (e.g. S-1150 -> H 1200 with 200 flange) are not separate catalogue sizes and are not implemented.
